verdict.rationale: Warp's docs list separate keyboard shortcuts for macOS and Windows/Linux, which implies the desktop terminal runs on all three. A newly announced settings file is described as giving 'easy portability between devices', which supports carrying the same config across machines. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of macOS/Linux/Windows availability, documentation that the settings file syncs or behaves identically across all three OSes, and independent hands-on confirmation of cross-platform config parity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the same terminal with the same config on macOS, Linux, and Windows

citations.quote: we are shipping a (long-overdue) settings file so that users and agents get programmatic control over settings and easy portability between devices.
